body:
### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/python/sglang/srt/speculative/dflash_utils.py#L147
```
acc_linear_penalties = getattr(sampling_info, "acc_linear_penalties", None)
```

While there's no `acc_linear_penalties` in [sampling_info](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/python/sglang/srt/sampling/sampling_batch_info.py#L29)

Should change to 

```
--- a/python/sglang/srt/speculative/dflash_utils.py
+++ b/python/sglang/srt/speculative/dflash_utils.py
@@ -143,7 +143,7 @@
             num_tokens_in_batch=draft_token_num,
         )
 
-    acc_linear_penalties = getattr(sampling_info, "acc_linear_penalties", None)
+    acc_linear_penalties = getattr(sampling_info, "acc_additive_penalties", None)
     penalizer = getattr(sampling_info, "penalizer_orchestrator", None)
     vocab_mask = getattr(sampling_info, "vocab_mask", None)
     logit_bias = getattr(sampling_info, "logit_bias", None)
--- a/python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_verify.py
+++ b/python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_verify.py
@@ -44,7 +44,7 @@
         return True
     if sampling_info.has_custom_logit_processor:
         return False
-    if getattr(sampling_info, "acc_linear_penalties", None) is not None:
+    if getattr(sampling_info, "acc_additive_penalties", None) is not None:
         return False
     penalizer = getattr(sampling_info, "penalizer_orchestrator", None)
     if penalizer is not None and penalizer.is_required:
```

### Reproduction

Start sglang with dspark:

```
sglang serve \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --tp 4 \
  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 \
  --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 30000
```

Send request setting `min_new_tokens`, but not work
```
{
  "model": "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly one short sentence."}],
  "max_tokens": 80,
  "min_tokens": 50,
  "temperature": 0
}
```

Live repro result:
HTTP 200
finish_reason: stop
completion_tokens: 18
content: "The sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of amber and rose."

Expected completion_tokens >= 50 with min_tokens=50, got: 3

### Environment

sglang v0.5.16, also in main branch
title: [Bug] DSPARK retrieves wrong key "acc_linear_penalities" from sampling_info
